name: Icy Scale Gauntlets
label: Quest
description: Icy Scale Gauntlets: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Thanks to you and Omarion (May he rest in peace), I am now able to create Icy Scale gauntlets. All you need to do is bring me the materials and pay a small crafting fee.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here is your order, friend. Delivered as promised!
